assets.name: VIORITH Mobile Camera Overlay

assets.name: Distributed Compute Fabric

assets.name: Adaptive Systems Intelligence Platform

assets.name: Interactive Piano Learning Platform
assets.description: Developed local-first piano-learning and transcription software with MIDI/acoustic feedback, score/audio workflows and a holdout-validated learned note-transcription default; later recovery candidates remain experimental and independent real-recording superiority is not claimed.

assets.name: Adaptive Audio MIDI Transcription Studio
assets.description: Local-first audio transcription prototype for stem separation, polyphonic audio-to-MIDI conversion, piano-roll review and multitrack MIDI export.

assets.name: ReserveFlow SaaS Platform
assets.description: Developed multi-tenant SaaS control platform with tenant isolation, role-based access, workspace persistence, billing-state controls, audit, deployment and operational foundations.

assets.name: VellumGrid Autonomous Commerce Platform
assets.description: Developed policy-governed digital-commerce platform for configurable product generation, Shopify integration, durable fulfillment, controlled delivery, profit-control evidence, production persistence and deployment governance; live Shopify production and measured profitability remain unestablished.

assets.name: Maastricht Digital Twin
assets.description: Runnable local geospatial digital-twin research workbench for Maastricht with offline data import, deterministic mobility simulation, browser exploration, replayable evidence and local persistence; bundled geometry is schematic and traffic behaviour remains uncalibrated.

assets.name: Maastricht Zero-Hour Simulator
assets.description: Unreal Engine driving-simulator foundation for Maastricht with C++ runtime architecture, vehicle and input foundations, telemetry and damage-model components plus repository validation; full-city fidelity, a compiled production baseline and validated vehicle physics remain unfinished.

assets.name: HΛRM LYRA Automotive / LYRA RS 3.6T
assets.description: Automotive engineering-analysis and simulation software for the HΛRM LYRA RS 3.6T program, with deterministic source/derived/evidence separation, canonical vehicle parameters, geometry, physics, digital-twin state and repository validation.

assets.name: LYRA-AERO eVTOL
assets.description: Analytical eVTOL digital-twin and simulation prototype with reproducible hover-power, disk-loading, cruise-lift, battery/endurance and deterministic design-space exploration; physical and certification evidence remain outside the present software baseline.

assets.name: Universal Capability Synthesis Engine (UCSE)
assets.description: Evidence-governed software-capability discovery, evaluation, benchmarking and synthesis engine with recursive decomposition, qualification gates, benchmark support, SQLite evidence state, hash-chained provenance and compatibility-aware system synthesis.
